Reading a paper

No more switching back and forth
between the PDF and a translator.

Side by side

Every paragraph has its translation right underneath

Two-column PDFs are reflowed into a single column, with formulas, tables, figures, and references left where they were. Translations line up paragraph for paragraph — when you get stuck, just glance below. One click shows only the original or only the translation, and you can always go back to the original PDF.

Library and glance

Drop a paper in and its title, authors, journal, and year fill in automatically. Click a paper and its one-page glance appears on the right: a one-sentence summary, the research question, methods, and key findings — and every item links back to the source.

Reflow engine

Fine reflow runs on the open-source MinerU, right on your computer — your papers are never uploaded. The first time you open {{名}} it downloads in the background (about 2 GB) and there's nothing you need to do; until it's ready, simple reflow still lets you read side by side, and it switches over to fine automatically once the download finishes. You can follow the progress in Settings under Reflow.

FAQ

{3}

Words you might not know

API Key: a string of characters your provider gives you. The app uses it to call the AI on your behalf, and you're billed for what you use.
Reflow: takes a PDF's two-column, page-by-page layout and re-flows it into a single column you can read side by side with the translation.
Glance: a one-page summary of key points the AI writes after reading the whole paper — every point links back to the original text.
